semanticFault.separateMutant: None. The original base is the credible semantic fault.

environment.owner: Existing runSandboxCommand supplies isolated HOME, TMPDIR and Git configuration. The adapter supplies an explicit Python and Moto environment.
environment.network: No credential, endpoint or proxy inheritance. This is not an OS network sandbox.
environment.pythonOwnership: Trusted helper, venv and pip commands use Python -I. Pinned pytest and installed plugins load before the current workspace is exposed. Root pytest.py and pip.py remain captured candidate files but do not own trusted imports.

capture: Existing owned supervisor, sandbox-command and implementation capture APIs only. Candidate commits and untracked files are captured.
copyAdaptation: adapter.ts and native-support.py adapt the existing FITS native fixture pattern. Exact third-party byte copies are in copy-ledger.json.
